caption: The video captures a calm, slow-moving stream bordered by dense green forest on both banks, viewed from a fixed, steady position over the water. The foreground surface is glassy and mirrors the surrounding trees and a soft pale sky, while two small rocks rest in the water, one near the shaded left bank. Sunlight strikes the right-side foliage more brightly than the darker left side, and the channel bends gently away into a brighter riffle of churning white water in the middle distance. Throughout the clip the water keeps moving gently. Small ripples and shimmering distort the mirrored tree reflections, which deform and shift slightly from moment to moment rather than sliding across the surface as separate objects. The white-water riffle in the middle distance flows steadily downstream, feeding the calm pool in front of the camera. Tiny bright specks drift faintly across the left foreground, while the surrounding forest itself remains essentially still. The camera framing stays constant, so the tree line, rocks, and bank positions hold their places without any pan or zoom.
